quick: Elemental zinc 15 to 25 mg daily (children with diarrhoea: 20 mg/day for 14 days, 10 mg under 6 months)
summary: Zinc bisglycinate is a chelated zinc salt with good absorption.
indications: Zinc deficiency; adjunct in diarrhoea in children (as zinc)

dosage.d: Elemental zinc 15 to 25 mg daily (children with diarrhoea: 20 mg/day for 14 days, 10 mg under 6 months)

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Nutritional supplement; clinical effects are modest or unproven.
preg: Dietary amounts are safe; supplement doses not established
lact: Dietary amounts are safe; supplement doses not established

moderate: Reduces absorption of tetracyclines, quinolones and penicillamine; long-term high doses cause copper deficiency

serious: Copper deficiency with prolonged high doses

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
